actions_or_findings.title: 1. AI019-B1 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — blank VLM output is recorded as success without explicit per-image failure
actions_or_findings.trigger: A Qwen-compatible VLM returns HTTP 200 with syntactically valid JSON whose description is absent or blank, or another VLMProvider returns VisionInsight(description="").
actions_or_findings.rationale: Impact: QwenVLMProvider converts the missing value to an empty string. AnalysisService then logs that call as SUCCESS with no error_code. In a partial run the image contributes an empty entry without an explicit failure; when all descriptions are blank, _run_vlm returns (None, None), so text fallback proceeds with no recorded image failure. This violates the scoped completion condition that every REPORT image either contributes understanding or has explicit per-image failure provenance. The new tests cover thrown ProviderError partial/all-failure cases but not successful-looking blank output.
